info.title: Runway API
info.description: Runway purchasing backend. Signed-in mode verifies Clerk (Google) session tokens and enforces server-owned roles; fixtures demo mode uses declared demo actors (meta.demoIdentity=true). All money is integer USD cents. Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. See docs/CONTRACT_V2.md and docs/CONTRACT_V3_EXECUTIVE_AUTH.md.
